sections.instruction: Rewrite the following story combining the sentences using a RELATIVE PRONOUN:
sections.contextText:
In 1956, a young sailor wrote a note. He felt very lonely. He put the note into a bottle. He threw the bottle into the ocean. In his note, he wanted any girl to write to him. A girl would find the bottle.

Two years later, a fisherman saw the sailor's bottle and picked it up. He was fishing on a shore in Sicily. As a joke, he gave it to his daughter. She wrote the sailor a letter. After more letters, the sailor married her in 1958. He visited Sicily.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: In 1956, a young sailor wrote a note. He felt very lonely. He put the note into a bottle. He threw the bottle into the ocean. In his note, he wanted any girl to write to him. A girl would find the bottle.
questions.modelAnswer: In 1956, a young sailor who felt very lonely wrote a note which he put into a bottle. He threw the bottle into the ocean. In his note, he wanted any girl who would find the bottle to write to him.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: Two years later, a fisherman saw the sailor's bottle and picked it up. He was fishing on a shore in Sicily. As a joke, he gave it to his daughter. She wrote the sailor a letter. After more letters, the sailor married her in 1958. He visited Sicily.
questions.modelAnswer: Two years later, a fisherman who was fishing on a shore in Sicily saw the sailor's bottle and picked it up. As a joke, he gave it to his daughter, who wrote the sailor a letter. After more letters, the sailor, who visited Sicily, married her in 1958.

Here's the shop where I bought my new camera.
